text:
Jordan Miles: Postmortem follow-up: we noted gaps in the runbook (missing safe-checks), the escalation matrix is out of date, and we should start tracking recurrence metrics. Need owners + due dates for edits.
Talia Gomez: I can own the runbook safe-checks + command snippets. aiming for Thu EOD.
Omar Farouk: I'll take the escalation matrix updates and paging thresholds. I want to map which teams to page at Sev2 vs Sev1. target next Tue.
Rina Patel: I'll add recurrence labels to the incident tracker and wire a saved query + dashboard tile. I can also draft a small playbook section for recurring patterns. target Mon.
Jordan Miles: great. please include the exact doc paths so I can link them in the postmortem tracker. Also add a small eval in the PR that compares MTTI before/after.
Talia Gomez: runbook commands I'll add will include idempotency notes and a "confirm state" step. sample snippets below.
Talia Gomez: ```
# verify model pool health (idempotent)
rwinfctl pool status --pool=gpu-fast | jq '.healthy'
# safe rollback: dry-run then apply
rwinfctl deploy rollback --deployment=redwood-runtime --to=3 --dry-run
rwinfctl deploy rollback --deployment=redwood-runtime --to=3
# flush cache safely (confirm prefix count first)
rwinfctl cache inspect --prefix=user:123 | wc -l
rwinfctl cache invalidate --prefix=user:123 --confirm
```
Omar Farouk: paging proposal: add a pre-page verification: "is spike from batch windows?" and extend transient window for p95 from 5m to 9m. will annotate which thresholds go into staging vs prod.
Rina Patel: recurrence plan: add label recurrence=true and recurrence_count. saved filter: "recurrence:yes AND created>=-30d". will create grafana panel for "recurring incident count" and link in playbook.
incident-bot: created INC-2024 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2024) "Runbook/escalation/recurrence followups" assigned to Talia, Omar, Rina. Due dates: Talia: 1930785600, Omar: 1931024800, Rina: 1930699200.
deploy-bot: noted - will not apply paging threshold changes to prod until staging sign-off.
Talia Gomez: doc paths: docs/runbooks/safe-checks/safe-ops.md
Omar Farouk: escalation doc: docs/runbooks/escalation/escalation-matrix.md (diagram attached in PR)
Rina Patel: recurrence playbook: docs/playbooks/recurrence/overview.md and dashboard link in PR.
Jordan Miles: please drop PR links here when opened and add the tiny eval (MTTI delta). I'll ping for reviews and mark the postmortem items closed after merges.
Talia Gomez: opening draft PR now. will include test plan + verification steps.
Omar Farouk: will update the paging diagram and add a short checklist for the oncall to follow before escalating.
Rina Patel: invite sent for "recurrence review" weekly sync — brings SRE + product + infra. template included in playbook.
Jordan Miles: perfect. thanks all. once PRs are merged i'll close INC-2024 and schedule a 2-week follow-up to ensure changes behave as expected. :thumbsup:
